description: Telecom / 3GPP / RAN domain relations, seeded from the closure test's telecom gap clusters (deployment events, handover, bearer/slice configuration, spectrum allocation). Fork this for your own operator/vendor domain. The lean core (../edge-ontology-reference.md) already covers ~96% of telecom prose; this pack names the register-specific residue.

deploys_launches.description: an operator or vendor launches, deploys, rolls out, or first-offers a network service, technology, or release in a market or at a time

hands_over.description: a network node hands over or transfers a session, call, or user to another node or cell

configures.description: a network function configures, establishes, provisions, or sets up a bearer, slice, channel, session, or connection

allocates.description: a system allocates, assigns, schedules, or grants spectrum, resources, capacity, or identifiers

interfaces_with.description: a network element interfaces, connects, or communicates with another over a defined reference point or interface

serves.description: a network node serves, covers, or provides service to a cell, area, session, or set of users
